description: Defines the EmployeeLeaveSearchFilterParams class which extends LeaveSearchFilterParams for filtering employee leave data based on criteria such as date ranges, statuses, employee number, and inclusion options within the OrangeHRM Leave module.

classes.name: EmployeeLeaveSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object for specifying search filters when querying employee leave records, including status filters, date ranges, employee identification, and inclusion options.

methods.name: getStatuses
methods.description: Returns the list of leave statuses as an array of strings or null.

methods.name: setStatuses
methods.description: Sets the leave statuses filter after validating against permitted statuses and mapping them via the leave request service.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the starting date filter as a DateTime object or null.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the ending date filter as a DateTime object or null.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number as an integer or null.

methods.name: getIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Returns the inclusion option as a string or null.

methods.name: setIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Sets the inclusion option for employees.
